text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) 2022.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2022

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi tiga ratus tiga puluh tiga juta

lapan ratus dua puluh enam ribu ringgit (RM333,826,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang

Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi

tahun 2022 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Maksud Amaun

 (RM)

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2022

IN excercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1) of the

Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System (Supply)

Regulations 2022.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2022

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding three hundred and thirty-three million

eight hundred and twenty-six thousand ringgit (RM333,826,000) from

the Employment Insurance Fund for the expenditure on administration of

the Employment Insurance System for the year 2022 is hereby authorized for the

purpose specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

 (RM)

Emoluments 123,775,000

Supplies and services 78,028,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 469,000

Other expenditures 39,644,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 91,910,000

_______________

 TOTAL 333,826,000

Made 28 October 2022

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(25); PN(PU2)747/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

 Minister of Human Resources
